Community heroes and scenarios now install from inside the game. The Mod Store opens in Extras with eight fan-made packs, from Carnage and Yondu to a battle for your soul against Mephisto. Every game you play can now be watched back as a replay, exported or shared, Past games keeps every finished game to look back on, the game has a website of its own, and the first new game screens speak Spanish.

Mods in the store

8

4 heroes, 2 scenarios and 2 house rules, each one vetted before it's listed.

Creators

7

made the packs, and @bluefireF5ran curated them.

Built-in packs

66

every product from the Core Set to wave 11, now defined the way a mod is.

The Mod Store opens

Issues #488, #661 and #677 · PR #489

@Kravenprime asked for Neptune's custom decks in the game. Here they are, and more. Open Extras ▸ Mod Store (Beta) to browse fan-made packs and read each one's cards, then install, update or remove it. A pack is checked and stored on your device, so it plays offline once it's in.

What's in the store

  • Heroes: Carnage by Neptune, Gwenpool by Patatasaurio, Night Thrasher by DesignHacker, and Yondu by DesignHacker and BlueHG.
  • Scenarios: Mephisto by Neptune, with four modular sets and Spanish card faces, and The Punisher by PermaKarma.
  • House rules: Lost Traits by Bluefire, and GMW Fixes by Gideon's Gaming and Bluefire, which brings the Balanced option for The Galaxy's Most Wanted.
  • Coming next: Throg by Patatasaurio and Caurel is in the game as a draft, and joins the store once its authors confirm the curators' fixes.

How mods play

  • Installed heroes join hero select and the deck builder under Custom packs, with a CUSTOM badge.
  • Pack scenarios show on Scenario select and pack modular sets on Table setup. House rules have their own tab.
  • A game keeps the packs it started with, so updating or removing one never changes a saved game.
  • A Mods family in the Trophy Room has 15 achievements. None give points, so mods never move your rank.

It's a beta

Every pack is fan-made, and many needed new rules in the game to work, so expect rough edges: a card that resolves oddly, or a picture that's missing. If something looks wrong, Report a problem is one tap away in the store. Want to make your own? The mod SDK and its mc-pack tool come with each release, and the creator template is public on GitHub.

Watch it back

Issues #693 and #706 · PRs #694 and #710

Any game can now be played back on the board like a video. Play, pause, step one move at a time, skip a round or drag the seek bar, at 1×, 2× or 4×. Watching never changes your save.

Where to find it

  • Watch replay on Game over.
  • Watch beside Resume on each game in progress on the title screen.
  • Open a replay in Extras, for a file someone sent you.
  • Past games, beside Extras on the title screen, for every game you've finished.

Share it

  • Export replay saves a file a friend can open in their game. Export log saves the whole game log as text.
  • Share link uploads the replay and gives you a link that opens it in the game.
  • Report a problem attaches your game as a replay, so a bug comes with the moves that caused it.

Past games lists every game you've finished, newest first, from its own button beside Extras on the title screen: the villain and heroes, won or lost and why, the rounds, the time played and who fell. Pick one for its details, then Watch, Share, Export or Log without leaving the screen. All, Wins and Losses tabs filter the list.

A home of its own

Issues #697 and #707 · PRs #698 and #708

The game has its own website now, champions-digital-game.com, led by the game's art: news, every hero and villain, the mods, downloads for your device and the community Discords, in English and Spanish. The game itself has moved to its own address, marvel.champions-digital-game.com, and the release reports are on champions-digital-game.com.

The game has moved

  • Saves in a web browser belong to its address, so the old address now shows a page that hands you your saves and your sync code, with the steps to bring them over.
  • The installed apps keep their saves, and nothing changes for them.
  • Links made for the old address, such as a shared replay, open at the new one.

New game speaks Spanish

Issue #390 · PR #719 by @bluefireF5ran

The Spanish reaches past the title menu. @bluefireF5ran translated the first screens of a new game: the guide chooser, Scenario select and the unlock prompts now read in Spanish when the game is in Spanish. The words follow the Spanish Rules Reference and the printed Spanish cards, written for players in Spain.

What's in Spanish now

  • The title menu, since v0.44.0.
  • The guide chooser, and Scenario select: its search, filters, shelves, stages, stats, side panel and your record.
  • The unlock prompts and lock captions, such as "Vence a Rhino para desbloquear Wave 1".
  • A screen switches language in place, the search box too.

Still in English

  • Card, villain, scenario, pack and wave names.
  • Every screen after Scenario select, for now.
  • Next up: the hero seats and deck check, then table setup and the mulligan.

You asked, we fixed

Issues #692, #700 and #717 · PRs #714 and #715

Three came from your reports, and two from a contributor who found and fixed them. Thank you, @AlecHolland1582, Funguykawhi and @bluefireF5ran.

#692 · reported by @AlecHolland1582

The Briefing stays drawn

On some Android phones the Briefing went blank when it asked a question with a speaker above it, such as Ronan's Kree Supremacy call after the Market. The speaker's portrait is now baked in, and the screen stays drawn.

#700 · reported by @AlecHolland1582

Stealth Training answers

Stealth Training now responds when you exactly defeat Secure the Landing Pad, even though it turns over to Cosmo first. The log names the side scheme, not Cosmo, for the threat removed and the defeat.

RRG 1.8 "Response", p. 38
#717 · reported by Funguykawhi on Discord

Kang's obligations take the right card

Discarding a resource to get rid of Kang's Temporal obligations now offers only cards with the printed resource it names, so picking a wild card no longer leaves Confirm stuck.

RRG 1.8 "Wild Resource", p. 48
#714 · fixed by @bluefireF5ran

Searches offer what can enter play

Build Support, Call for Backup and Lock and Load let each player search for a card and put it into play. They now offer only cards that can enter play: not a unique card already in play, and not an upgrade with nothing to attach to. A search that finds nothing says so in the log.

RRG 1.8 "Target", p. 43
#715 · fixed by @bluefireF5ran

An empty search still resolves

A required search of your deck and discard pile can be made with nothing to find, as any search can, and a "then" after a search that found nothing is skipped, as the rules say.

RRG 1.8 "Target", p. 43; "Then", p. 44

Also in v0.45.0

Rules, art, polish and what's next

Rules

  • An attack can ignore guard for the whole attack, past a guard minion to the villain, and it triggers "after you ignore guard".
  • An enemy attacked by another enemy, such as by Moondragon or Headpool, now triggers its own "when attacked" abilities: Shocker, Speed Demon, Gorgon, Whiplash, Temporal Shield on Kang and more.
  • Amplify follows Fear No Evil's updated rule, so villainous heroes and allies get it too, and boost cards given ahead of time resolve on the next basic power.

Art and the road ahead

  • Captain America, Ms. Marvel, Thor, Black Widow and Hulk use new scans of their hero and nemesis cards, and Vision's Intangible face is a scan too.
  • Elektra and Iron Fist are on the way. Their cards are in and scripted, but they stay hidden until their missing cards are in.
  • Every product, Core Set to wave 11, is now built the way a mod is. Nothing changes in play.
  • The FFG rulings transcript now runs to October 12, 2026.

Smoother, and up to date

  • Moving between screens is smooth (#712). Title, Extras and the Mod Store fade in already fully drawn, instead of filling in and blinking, and the Extras tabs switch without a hitch.
  • Less work on the main thread (#716, #722): progress and pictures are prepared in workers, so screen changes hitch far less.
  • Every dependency is on its latest compatible version.
  • The project's current status and architecture pages are up to date, including how the content, mod template and Mod Store registry repositories feed the game.

Thank you!
